title: Introduce ENC_BCD_ODD_NUM_DIG in order to handle odd number of digits
description:
In BCD strings with odd number of digits the last byte high nibble is a filler which can be 0.
In order to be able to exlude it from the string we need to know if there is odd or even number of digits.
